profile.headline: Business Development and Web Management
profile.summary: I am a recent MBA - Accounting graduate from Louisiana State University Shreveport.  I aim to further my management and accounting skills in each job opportunity I undertake in order to establish a fulfilling and career path. I enjoy people and problem-solving and therefore look forward to facing challenges throughout my career.

positions.title: Business Development and Web Manager
positions.description: As Business Development and Marketing Manager, it is my responsibility to oversee the use of online media platforms, ensuring they are being used in the most effective manner. I manage our site content, working with advertising coordinators to maximize outreach. My position requires the understanding of the estimate and bid process for large-scale projects. Lastly, it is essential that I ensure that CleanSweep remains an integral member of industry professional organizations both locally and nationwide.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Social Media Marketing · Industry Outreach · Microsoft Excel · Office 365

positions.title: Bridal Consultant, Social Media Manager
positions.description:
As a consultant, my responsibilities include developing and maintaining client relations, working knowledge of all designers and gowns, as well as maintaining all aspects of social media.  
I also edit, manage, and redesign the business website as needed.
From creating a spreadsheet expediting the closing of sales to writing general contracts for clients, I worked beyond the scope of my responsibilities to benefit the business as much as possible.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: As a manager, I am responsible for in-depth product knowledge, maintaining positive client relations and experiences, and acting as a median between sales representatives and the company's clientele.

positions.title: Design Assistant
positions.description: Main responsibilities include the construction of couture gowns, knowledge of industry techniques, and problem solving in a busy environment.

positions.title: Gallery guide
positions.description: My main responsibilities as a gallery guide primarily consisted of detailed historical knowledge and giving informational tours to groups of museum visitors.
